name: Bag of Cheer
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, very rare*

**Weight:** 30 lb

---

This large sack, which weighs 30 pounds and is made from red velvet, appears to be full of presents in colorful wrapping. As a Magic action, you can pull a present from the bag and give it to another creature. The gift is tailored specifically to the recipient; the GM determines its nature or rolls on the Gifts table. The value of the gift can't exceed 100 GP.

Once three presents have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn. Any additional presents removed from the bag are empty but well-decorated boxes.

| d10 | Gift |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | A weapon or Shield |
| 2 | Gold Pieces |
| 3 | An art object |
| 4 | Fine Clothes |
| 5 | A tool or Musical Instrument |
| 6 | Potion of Healing |
| 7 | Gems |
| 8 | An exotic food |
| 9 | A Book |
| 10 | A toy or Gaming Set |

name: Gambler's Coin
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, rare (Requires Attunement)*

---

This Gold Piece has deep scratches on one side. It has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. When you make a D20 Test|XPHB, you can expend 1 charge to replace the d20 roll with a coin flip. On heads, the roll is treated as a 20 (though you don't score a Critical Hit|XPHB with an attack roll or activate any other effects which trigger on the roll of a 20). On tails, the roll is treated as a 1.

name: Leaden Manacles
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, uncommon*

---

These magical Manacles are used to restrain spellcasters. When a creature attempts to cast a spell or take the Magic action while it is bound with these Manacles, it makes a DC 20 ability check using its spellcasting ability. On a failure, the spell or Magic action fails and the creature takes 4d6 Fire damage. The spell slot or use of that Magic action is wasted, as well as the action, Bonus Action|XPHB, or Reaction|XPHB taken.

name: Nolzur's Painted World
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, legendary*

---

This masterful painting, which is either Medium or Large, was crafted by a master painter using at least ten pots of Nolzur's Marvelous Pigments. The painting depicts a serene painted world and acts as a portal to a demiplane in which that world exists. Creatures of the painting's size or smaller can pass through the portal into the demiplane.

Inside the painted world, a portal to the real world appears as a misty archway. If the face of the painting is blocked, the misty archway in the demiplane disappears. The location, objects, and creatures depicted within the painted world are determined by the painting's creator. Such objects and creatures dissipate into smoke if removed from the painting. Time passes at half speed within the painted world.

name: Soul Figurine
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, uncommon (Requires Attunement)*

---

This smiling, human-shaped figurine contains a reserve of life force. If you drop to 0 Hit Points|XPHB while attuned to the figurine, roll 2d10 + 10. Your Hit Points|XPHB instead change to the number rolled. The figurine's expression becomes sorrowful and the figurine becomes nonmagical.

name: Weapon Charms
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, varies (Requires Attunement)*

---

A Weapon Charm is a small ornament fixed on a loop of string or chain. You can take a Magic action to attach the charm to a weapon, usually on the weapon's pommel, or remove it from one. Attaching a charm causes the weapon to become a magic weapon that requires attunement. If the weapon is already magical, you must attune to it again to gain the charm's magical benefits, which are listed in the charm's description. A weapon can only have one attached charm at a time.
